tests.description: Timed check on The Rise of the Nazis

questions.question: Explain why the Wall Street Crash helped the Nazis. (4 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: The Wall Street Crash caused American banks to recall loans from Germany, triggering economic collapse. By 1932, 6 million were unemployed. The Weimar government could not solve the crisis, and Brüning governed by decree, undermining democracy. Desperate Germans turned to extremist parties - the Nazis promised "Bread and Work" and someone to blame (Versailles, Jews, Communists).

questions.question: How important was propaganda in the rise of the Nazis? (8 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: Propaganda was very important: Goebbels used rallies, posters, newspapers and radio to create the Hitler Myth and target different groups with tailored messages ("Bread and Work" for the unemployed, anti-Communism for the middle class). questions.question: "The Nazis rose to power because of the economic crisis." How far do you agree? (12 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: The economic crisis was the essential trigger: unemployment rose to 6 million by 1932, the government cut welfare, and democratic politicians seemed incapable of solving the crisis. The Nazi vote rose from 2.6% (1928) to 37.3% (July 1932) directly because of economic collapse.
